incbot: :rotating_light: Pager alert (sev2) — KV cache paging surge + intermittent NCCL stalls on tp-group us-east-1/gpu-pool-3. Trigger: continuous-batching backpressure + uneven slab allocation. Root ts=1768504321

Tom (oncall): I'm on it. Seeing host gpu-node-7 and gpu-node-9 with huge page faults, swap activity 3-4x baseline. Latency spikes on hosted API route /v1/generate: p95 -> 1.2s from 120ms.

Maya (eng-runtime): details? any recent rollout?

Raj (eng-sre): No infra deploys in last 12h. There was an autoscaler tweak to `continuous_batch.max_window` in the runtime config ~30m ago (rolled by deploy-bot). Could be related.

Tom (oncall): attaching quick profile:```
GPU 7: KV page faults: 12k/min, CPU swap: high
GPU 9: KV page faults: 11.5k/min
NCCL: stall observed 2x in last 5m with timeouts around 120s
Logs: kv_shard_rebalance: found uneven slab sizes (1.8x variance)
```

Maya (eng-runtime): that matches a regression I saw in local repro — slab allocator didn't apply modulo sharding after the batching change. Continuous batching increased KV cache size per request and exposed uneven partitioning.

Zoe (ml-infra): customer impact? which tenants hit this hard?

Eileen (support): CS dashboard shows increased error rates for 12 customers in us-east-1, highest for customer 'AcmeRetail' — calls returning 504s and timeouts. We're getting inbound slack threads from two CSMs.

Tom (oncall): mitigation proposal: 1) disable continuous batching on pool (hot-config) 2) revert `continuous_batch.max_window` to previous value 3) push hotfix that forces slab rebalancing before next allocation 4) roll controlled restart of runtime on affected nodes.

Maya (eng-runtime): agree. I can push config rollback via runtime-console now. Hotfix patch ready (branch: fix/kv-modulo-rebalance). Patch is small but requires binary restart to pick up allocator change.

Raj (eng-sre): I'll do the targeted hot-config flip for continuous batching to false on gpu-pool-3 to stop growth. Command: ``rdctl config set --pool gpu-pool-3 continuous_batch.enabled=false``. Planning to do in 1 minute.

deploy-bot: Scheduled change: rdctl config set --pool gpu-pool-3 continuous_batch.enabled=false by raj_sre at 1768504365 — in 30s.

Tom (oncall): perform canary restart on gpu-node-7 after config flips, check NCCL stalls. If canary looks good, roll to gpu-node-9 and the rest.

Maya (eng-runtime): hotfix build uploaded: `registry/redwood/runtime:kv-rebalance-176850` — recommending canary on node-7. Patch forces kv-shard assignment via consistent-hash+modulo and triggers local slab compaction on startup.

Tom (oncall): canary restart done on gpu-node-7 (1768504380). Observing: page faults down 70%, NCCL stall not seen in last 60s. p95 on canary node route dropped to 160ms.

Zoe (ml-infra): good sign. Start rolling to gpu-node-9. Tom will coordinate drain/cordon.

Tom (oncall): rolling to gpu-node-9 and remaining 3 nodes in pool. ETA 12m. I'll post status updates.

Eileen (support): letting impacted CSMs know: temporary degraded performance, mitigation applied, doing rolling fix, ETA ~15m. Asking for any business-critical customers to escalate.

Maya (eng-runtime): after full roll, we should re-enable a smaller `continuous_batch.max_window` value and enforce slab size caps. Also will add a health-check to detect slab variance >1.5x and trigger preemptive compaction.

Raj (eng-sre): postmortem checklist: capture heap snapshots from affected nodes, KV slab metrics, timeline of continuous-batching parameter changes, and number of outstanding cached keys per shard.

Tom (oncall): update 1768504425: roll complete on pool; all nodes running `kv-rebalance-176850`. Global p95 returned to baseline 130ms; page faults down to normal. No further NCCL stalls reported.

deploy-bot: Change complete: rdctl config set --pool gpu-pool-3 continuous_batch.enabled=false by raj_sre at 1768504410.

Zoe (ml-infra): customer impact summary: 12 customers affected briefly; 2 saw >3m elevated error windows; no data loss. CS notified.

Eileen (support): sent update to CSMs and ACME ops, they acknowledged.

Maya (eng-runtime): follow-ups: 1) revert continuous_batch.enabled=false only after we safely re-evaluate smaller window and slab caps (postmortem), 2) backfill unit/e2e tests for slab sharding under high-batch scenarios, 3) add alert when KV slab variance > threshold.

Tom (oncall): handing off to Raj for postmortem owner. I'm going offline after monitoring for another 10m.

Raj (eng-sre): taking postmortem owner. I'll sync with Maya/Zoë and schedule an incident review.

incbot: Incident ticket created: INC-2026-030-021 at 1768504440 (owner: raj_sre).

(END THREAD)
